title: Security-Proven Adaptation of Row-Reduced GaXR under a psPRP Assumption
summary: The row-reduced GaXR scheme offers three-row garbled tables, but a security-proven adaptation under a suitable psPRP assumption remains open.

formal_statement.body: Construct a security-proven adaptation of the row-reduced GaXR garbling scheme under a suitable public-seed pseudorandom permutation (psPRP) assumption. GaXR uses row reduction so that each gate has only three rows in its garbled table, and adapting it to security under a suitable psPRP assumption does not appear to have a simple and clear solution. The unresolved task is therefore to give such an adaptation and prove its security under an appropriate psPRP assumption.

scope.domain: This concerns the design and security of row-reduced GaXR garbling schemes under public-seed pseudorandom permutation assumptions.
assumptions: a suitable public-seed pseudorandom permutation (psPRP) assumption
parameters: three rows per gate in the garbled table (the row-reduction property)
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct an adaptation of the row-reduced GaXR scheme and prove its security under an appropriate psPRP assumption.

progress.summary: The source explicitly notes that adapting GaXR for security under a suitable psPRP assumption does not appear to have a simple and clear solution. It leaves this adaptation as an open problem.
citation_labels: Pratik Soni et al., Public-Seed Pseudorandom Permutations
